description: A Perl script for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images, including reading, writing, layout, and partition table management.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads data to a total length with 0xFF bytes.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block size greater than or equal to given length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition entry with name, address, size, and optional skips.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry into name, offset, size, and skips.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Extracts partition table from firmware data if present.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses a partition table into an array of partition info.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 block.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Generates trailer data (not used currently).

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints contents of RedBoot trailer.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and adjusts Kernel and Ramdisk offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partition info based on firmware's partition table.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity check for partition table data.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints partition information.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns default partition layout.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Verifies and assigns start and size for partitions based on layout rules.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds binary partition table from partition info.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Writes firmware image file from partition data.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads firmware image file into partition data.

methods.name: writeOutFirmwareParts
methods.description: Writes partition data to individual files.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads partition data from individual files.
